title: Set up VocabX
welcomeText: VocabX helps you learn foreign words so they really stick: cards come back right when a word starts to fade. A few minutes of setup and your first stack is ready. You can change everything later.
nativeHint: Translations will be shown in it.
targetHint: Pick one or more — each has its own progress.
checkSkip: Skip the test and start from scratch
restoreHint: Restore your progress from a file exported from VocabX.
pointMemoryText: The FSRS algorithm decides when to show a word so you do not forget it — with no needless repeats.
pointLevelsText: From recognising a word to hearing it and recalling it yourself — as soon as you are ready.
pointBuddyTitle: A buddy that grows with you
pointBuddyText: Your character cheers your progress and earns new levels and clothes for daily practice.
pointOfflineText: Your data stays in your browser; make a backup at any time.
startHint: Take a short test and we will pick a word set for your level. Or start with a clean slate.
testText: {lang}: cards from A1 up. Know the word — swipe right, not — swipe left. About two minutes.
scratchText: No ready-made sets: you will add your own words. Ready decks are always waiting in the library.
checkHint: Pick the right translation of the word. Not sure? Tap “I don’t know”.
resultText: We will add the “{deck}” set: {count, plural, one {# word} other {# words}} to learn. Words you already know are left out.
retake: Take the test again with other words
